message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way to regain access is to use the “Forgot password?” or “Reset password” option on the login page. That will send a secure link to your registered email address, allowing you to set a new password.

Let me know if you’d like instructions on how to reset it or if there’s anything else I can help with!
